notes: No active concurrent work was found touching training, learning, practice, recognition, or CLPR paths as of HEAD 5348202. 20 worktrees and 2 open PRs (#66, #63) exist repo-wide but none overlap the allowed_additions/allowed_existing_file_edits lists above; re-verify at apply time if HEAD has moved.

PATCH_MANIFEST.json's targetPaths for the app side (app/src/features/learning-practice/*) and the fixture (data/synthetic-cases/clpr-central-intake-contradiction-v1.json) are superseded by this file — see CLPR_INTEGRATION_RESOLUTION.md sections C and D for why.

PATCH_MANIFEST.json's requiredExistingFileEdits list omits tsconfig.json and vitest.config.ts, both of which use literal per-package maps (not globs) and must be edited for the new package's imports to resolve at all; both are included in allowed_existing_file_edits above.

The role-family string used throughout the package source ('CENTRAL_INTAKE_COORDINATOR') does not match the live UserRole enum value ('INTAKE_COORDINATOR') and must be corrected in seed.ts, recognition.ts, and the relocated fixture file before merge.

data/synthetic-cases/ is blocked outright: it is schema-validated (SyntheticCaseSchema) and load-tested (tests/data/synthetic-cases.test.ts) as BehavioralHealthCase fixtures; the CLPR practice-scenario fixture has an incompatible shape and must not be added there under any adaptation.

IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md is listed as an allowed existing-file edit only for the standard session-close status update described in the project's operating rules; it is optional and not required for the slice to function or pass verification.
